description: This Dart class manages the reading state for an ebook reader application, including loading book details, chapters, bookmarks, and handling navigation between chapters.

classes.name: ReaderProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier that manages the current reading state, including book details, chapter navigation, and bookmarks.

methods.name: openBook
methods.description: Opens a book given its composed ID, loads its details, and the current reading progress including the first chapter.

methods.name: _loadChapter
methods.description: Private method to load the content of the current chapter, updating the chapter content or handling errors.

methods.name: nextChapter
methods.description: Advance to the next chapter if available, loading its content and updating progress.

methods.name: prevChapter
methods.description: Go back to the previous chapter if available, loading its content and updating progress.

methods.name: addBookmark
methods.description: Add a bookmark at a specified position in the current chapter, optionally with a note, and save it.
